scope: Three accepted original KiCad development projects plus multichannel sibling; offline pedigree audit only

structural_screen_reuse.method_limits: Terminal geometry excludes pad names, net/pin labels and UUIDs; footprint local pad geometry retains pad numbers and relative coordinates but excludes absolute board placement. Connectivity screen is three-round colored bipartite footprint/net multigraph refinement with pad labels; removes refdes/netnames/UUIDs/routes. This is a coarse screen, not graph-isomorphism proof, rotation-invariant geometry proof or ancestry evidence.
structural_screen_reuse.interpretation: Three different whole-design screens, not an independence/ancestry/isomorphism proof
